title: I Reported the Hallway Elliptical With the Serial on the No-Storage Sign

parts.text: I reported the hallway elliptical at 8:22 p.m. with the serial on the no-storage sign. The machine blocked the exit light. I was thirty-two, renter, standing in a hall that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the serial, the sign, and the blocked light. Management tagged it for pickup and dated the notice. I keep the light photo. The hall finally knows a serial from storage.

social.video_title: The hallway elliptical blocked the exit light — Part 1/1
social.description: Serial on the no-storage sign, blocked exit light, a pickup tag. Has a hallway ever become a gym?
